title: Connect another app
description: Choose an OpenAI-compatible provider in the other app and enter these connection details.
running: Server running. Keep Rey30 IDvj open while using the connection.
stopped: Server stopped. Configure a local model and select Start server above to use this URL.
invalidAddress: Check the server port and API prefix in Configuration. Start the server first if its port is assigned automatically.
baseUrl: Base URL · apps on this computer
keyHelp: Paste this key in the other app's API key field. Change it from Configuration while the server is stopped.
noKeyHelp: Loopback connections do not require a key. If the other app requires a value, enter local. Create a key before starting the server to enable authentication.
chooseModel: Select the server's default model above
configHelp: The configuration does not include your secret key. Replace <API_KEY> with the separately copied key.
localHelp: This URL works on this computer. It is not a public internet link.
lanHelp: For another computer on your local network, replace 127.0.0.1 with this computer's private IP. Network access requires an API key and the appropriate network permissions. This does not create a public link.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the field and copy it manually.
keyFailed: A secure key could not be generated on this device.
networkKeyRequired: Set an API key in Configuration before allowing network access, or listen only on 127.0.0.1.
executeToolsHelp: Allow chat requests to use server tools when enabled.
